Recorded claim:
The accepted 2024 LDAP layout patch moved fields but left the hostname input with aria-labelledby="descriptionLabel" even though the visible hostname label is hostnameLabel. The current checkout still shows that mismatch. Review discussion covered layout and dismissal, not this label relationship. When touching this dialog, check each input’s aria-labelledby or control target against its own label; do not treat the prior accepted visual cleanup as accessibility validation. This is an observed gap, not an accepted style choice.

Provenance: 1eec7750fcef800c1eb84c661c6f5717a750af69c47957f3b1482b63907b181f. Original evidence IDs: 2a24648ee48d31538bf162d2fa771fcd0f146e7f798e4609e5219c0affe1d5b1, 9e7cb1130980d1a4d33d1645c0087d145b2f700635650530203c85a4f7bfa947, a9877db9e7720089cd8bb9937a6b4c0eb1e4b0e9d96da47dfe90b614438e10a8.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
